$schema: Content recovery music manifest. Records provenance for every locally-bundled ambient/region music track. See CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md for the general provenance rule, and RECOVERY_TODO.md 'Sound policy' row for status history.
licenseNote: This is fan-preserved audio recovered from a YouTube playlist and a fan-circulated 'Glitch Soundtrack MP3.zip' bundle, not an officially re-hosted release from Tiny Speck/Glitch. It is bundled here on that basis (matching the project's existing 'preserve what would otherwise be lost' posture for other dead-host assets), not because clean rights have been independently re-verified. If a rights holder objects, remove the affected files under coUclient/web/files/sounds/music/ and delete/blank the corresponding entries in coUclient/web/files/json/music.json and this manifest.

runtimeMechanism.description: Per-region ambient music triggering already existed end-to-end before this change (server hubdata.json 'music' key -> client mapData.getSong() -> Street.load() -> audio.setSong()). This pass only added real local audio files for that existing key namespace and a local-file fallback path in SoundManager.loadSong() so playback works without a SoundCloud API token.
runtimeMechanism.keyNamespace: coUclient/web/files/json/music.json (SoundCloud scid manifest) and coUserver/lib/common/mapdata/json/hubdata.json 'music' field per hub share one flat key namespace (e.g. 'forest', 'ix', 'firebog'). Local files use the exact same keys.
runtimeMechanism.trigger: coUclient/lib/src/game/street.dart Street.load() calls audio.setSong(streetData['music'] ?? mapData.getSong(label)); mapData.getSong() resolves street-level 'music' override, else the street's hub's 'music' field, else default 'forest'.
runtimeMechanism.localPlaybackChange: coUclient/lib/src/systems/audio.dart SoundManager.loadSong(): for any key listed in the new `localMusicTracks` constant, constructs a Scound pointed at files/sounds/music/<key>.<extension> instead of requiring a SoundCloud API token. Falls through to the pre-existing SoundCloud path for any other key. _playSong()'s browser-support check was also generalized from a hardcoded 'audio/mp3' to 'audio/$extension' so it correctly gates on ogg (the local files' actual format) rather than always testing mp3 support.
runtimeMechanism.multiTrackRotationNote: The original 2013 game server (tmp/glitch-gameserver/main.js doLoginStart) built a per-region ARRAY of tracks with server-side random-ish rotation (e.g. 7 Firebogs tracks, 18 Ix tracks). The already-built local revival's client/server architecture (music.json + hubdata.json 'music') is single-track-per-key, not array-based, and this pass intentionally matches that existing architecture rather than reintroducing per-region arrays -- see 'multi-track rotation' follow-up in RECOVERY_TODO.md.

sources.description: User-provided YouTube playlist preserving the official Glitch soundtrack after the original c2.glitch.bz hosting went dead.
sources.fetchTool: yt-dlp 2026.08.19, audio extracted via ffmpeg postprocessor
sources.note: All 23 playlist videos were downloaded (audio + info.json metadata) to a local scratch directory for matching; only the tracks listed below were confidently matched to a music_map/hub region and copied into the repo. The rest were NOT copied into the repo (see 'unmatchedPlaylistTracks' below) -- they remain only in the local scratch/download area, not committed.

sources.description: Pre-existing 'Glitch Soundtrack MP3.zip' already present in the repo root (gitignored, not committed -- see RECOVERY_TODO.md). Contains the official 'Soundscapes of Ur' ambient album (14 tracks, one per region) and the 'Glitch Variations' remix album (29 tracks, mostly one-off/quest/location themes). Used here only to fill region keys the YouTube playlist did not cover by an exact or near-exact region-name title match.

unmatchedRegions.reason: Neither the YouTube playlist nor the zip album has a track titled after any of this hub group's names (Bortola/Brillah/Haraiva/Karnata/Muufo/'forest_slow'). Guessing an unrelated track's identity for this key would violate the project's no-silent-guess rule (CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md). SoundManager.loadSong() has no local entry for 'forest_slow', so streets in this hub group currently produce no ambient music client-side (same silent-no-music behavior as every other region had before this change, not a regression) -- see RECOVERY_TODO.md follow-up.
